welcome.creatorBody: Player One IQ helps you grow your brand, connect platforms, discover sponsorship opportunities, and manage deals in one place. This quick setup takes about two minutes.
creatorBullets: Connect your social platforms for growth analytics
Browse and apply to sponsorship opportunities
welcome.sponsorBody: Run campaigns, review creators, manage contracts, and coordinate partnerships from a single portal built for brand teams.
sponsorBullets: Message partners without leaving the portal
welcome.agencyBody: Manage creators, sponsors, contracts, opportunities, and team workflows from one premium workspace. Let's walk through the essentials.
agencyBullets: Organize creators and sponsors in one roster
Post opportunities and manage deal flow
Invite your team with role-based access

connect.title: Connect your platforms
connect.subtitle: Link YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, or TikTok to unlock growth analytics, revenue tracking, and a stronger creator profile for sponsors.
connect.betaNote: During beta, YouTube uses Google sign-in. If Google blocks access, your workspace admin must add your Gmail as a Google OAuth test user. TikTok requires Login Kit to be configured for this app.
connect.profileLink: You can add more platforms or enter handles manually later from <link>your creator profile</link>.
connect.linkingFallbackBody: Your creator profile is still linking. You can connect platforms from your portal profile right after setup.

finish.title: You're all set
finish.body: Your workspace is ready. When you enter your {destination}, we'll walk you through each area with a quick guided tour — highlighting where to find opportunities, messages, contracts, and more.
